en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a row of ornate multi‑story buildings along a street at the edge of a forested hillside. The central building is labeled "Hotel Post" and features a mansard roof and decorative façade. Other commercial buildings with shop awnings line the street, and a bridge and trees appear in the lower right. Red printed captions at the top read place and street names in German.
